icon.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE premium mobile game app icon for DEWHAVEN, an original cozy pixel-art farming and valley adventure game. A small antique brass key is leaning beside the doorway, a tiny fresh green sprout near the threshold. Dark forest-teal background with a soft circular halo of dusk light; warm copper, rich pine, ivory and golden amber palette. Highly crafted hand-painted 3D storybook game icon, clean bold silhouette, tactile roof tiles, exquisite focused lighting and depth, restrained detail, polished premium indie-game branding, clear and identifiable at 48px. Keep all essential forms comfortably inside central 78% for app-store corner masking. Full square corners, no rounded outer border, no baked drop shadow outside icon. No people, no human faces, no portraits, no animals, no busy landscape, no badges, no watermarks, no stars or ratings.
